Forkray F-Droid repository
Forkray 的 F-Droid 仓库

Forkray, a fork of v2rayNG, compiled from source on GitHub Actions. Every release publishes a build manifest with the exact sources, toolchain and checksums, so it can be rebuilt and compared. Source: https://github.com/AcideFluorhydrique/v2rayNG

Forkray 是 v2rayNG 的分支，全部在 GitHub Actions 上从源代码构建。每个版本都附带构建清单，列出确切的源代码、工具链和校验和，可以重新构建并逐字节比对。

Add the repository · 添加仓库

In your F-Droid client (F-Droid, Droid-ify, Neo Store…), add this address, or scan the QR code. Then install and update Forkray from there.

在 F-Droid 客户端（F-Droid、Droid-ify、Neo Store 等）中添加下面的地址，或扫描二维码，之后即可在客户端里安装和更新 Forkray。

Mirrors · 镜像

The same repository on other hosts, for when the main address is slow or blocked. Add any one that your device can reach. A mirror needs no extra trust: your F-Droid client accepts an index only if it is signed with the key below, and once it has the repository it learns of every address here and switches between them by itself.

同一个仓库在其他站点上的副本，供主地址缓慢或无法访问时使用。添加任意一个你的设备能连上的地址即可。镜像不需要额外信任：F-Droid 客户端只接受用下方密钥签名的索引；添加仓库之后，客户端会自动得知这里列出的全部地址，并在它们之间自行切换。
